steps.name: fit rain on S2, fold 2022 held out
fit t2m on S1, fold 2022 held out
fit wind on S1, fold 2022 held out
fit mslp on S1, fold 2022 held out

notes: Rain truth: CHIRPS 2.0, block mean to the model grid, land only: rain is scored and weighted over land; sea cells are blank. T2m, wind and MSLP truth: ERA5.
Weights for this date are fitted without its year 2022 (out-of-sample).
Rung per variable: rain B2c, t2m B2c, wind B2c, mslp B2.
Grid 1.5° (~166 km); values are cell averages.
Heat-wave guidance unavailable: forecasts are 00 UTC (05:30 IST); the heat rule needs an afternoon (12 UTC) value.
Wind particles unavailable: u/v components are not in the cache.

extremes.name: Heavy rain (top 5 %)
extremes.threshold: 24 h rain above the cell's 95th percentile (training years)

extremes.name: Very heavy rain (top 1 %)
extremes.threshold: 24 h rain above the cell's 99th percentile (training years)

extremes.name: Rain ≥ 25 mm
extremes.threshold: 24 h rain ≥ 25 mm averaged over the grid cell

extremes.name: Hot (top 5 %)
extremes.threshold: 2 m temperature above the cell's 95th percentile (training years)

extremes.name: Very hot (top 1 %)
extremes.threshold: 2 m temperature above the cell's 99th percentile (training years)

extremes.name: Strong wind (top 5 %)
extremes.threshold: 10 m wind above the cell's 95th percentile (training years)

extremes.name: Very strong wind (top 1 %)
extremes.threshold: 10 m wind above the cell's 99th percentile (training years)

extremes.name: Heat wave (IMD rule)
extremes.note: Heat-wave guidance unavailable: forecasts are 00 UTC (05:30 IST); the heat rule needs an afternoon (12 UTC) value.
